title: Finite-dimensional twisted traces and finite-parameter nondegenerate short star-products for conical symplectic quantizations with reductive graded Poisson automorphisms
author: Pavel Etingof; Douglas Stryker
source_title: Short Star-Products for Filtered Quantizations, I
difficulty_reason: The proof identifies nondegenerate short products with filtered twisted traces and bounds their parameter space by fixed-scheme Poisson homology. The semisimple case uses an associated-graded commutator quotient and finite symplectic-leaf geometry. The nonsemisimple case requires a nilpotent Jordan degeneration and an injective leading-trace argument, rather than merely importing Poisson-homology finiteness.
source_version: Official SIGMA 16 (2020) article 014, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2020.014; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Read the complete local chain behind Theorem3.15: inner-derivation support and finite fixed-scheme argument, twisted-trace orthogonal-complement construction3.3, semisimple symbol/fixed-Poisson scheme proof3.11, and full nilpotent degeneration3.14 including injectivity of T->T0 via the first nonzero coefficient and h-commutators. Finite Poisson homology for finite-leaf schemes, conical finite-leaf geometry and Jacobson-Morozov are identified established prior background. The theorem is selected once with every new support proof bundled, not as a one-line application of those results. The twisted bimodule requires an actual filtration-preserving automorphism of the chosen quantization, as in3.11; no unqualified lifting of every graded automorphism for every quantization is asserted.

statement_scope: Theorem3.15 in its defined twisted-bimodule scope: X a normal conical symplectic singularity over C, A=O(X) graded with A0=C and Poisson bracket degree -2, reductive dilation-invariant Poisson automorphism group, and a Z/2-equivariant filtered quantization boldA. The chosen g is an actual filtration-preserving automorphism of boldA commuting with parity s, with graded image in that group. For its semisimple part g0, dim HH0(boldA,boldA g)^s <= dim HP0(X^g0)^s < infinity. Nondegenerate short star-products, if they exist, have the stated finite-dimensional trace parametrization up to normalization/scaling. No existence of such products, positivity, or arbitrary graded-automorphism lifting is added.
